examples.chinese: A：你喜歡臺灣嗎？ B：我喜歡臺灣。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xǐhuān Táiwān ma? B: Wǒ xǐhuān Táiwān.
examples.english: A: Do you like Taiwan? B: I like Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡台灣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan Táiwān.
examples.english: I like Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 我是印尼人。妳喜歡台灣嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Yìnní rén. Nǐ xǐhuān Táiwān ma?
examples.english: I am from Indonesia. Do you like Taiwan?

examples.chinese: 我喜歡喝茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān hē chá.
examples.english: I like to drink tea.

examples.chinese: 我很喜歡做飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zuòfàn.
examples.english: I like cooking very much.

examples.chinese: 他很喜歡看書。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān kànshū.
examples.english: He likes reading books very much.

examples.chinese: 你喜歡喝哪種茶？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān hē nǎ zhǒng chá?
examples.english: What kind of tea do you like?

examples.chinese: 你喜歡什麼顏色？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān shénme yánsè?
examples.english: What color do you like?

examples.chinese: A：你喜歡紅色的筆嗎？ B：我喜歡白的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xǐhuān hóngsè de bǐ ma? B: Wǒ xǐhuān bái de.
examples.english: A: Do you like red pens? B: I like white pens.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸喜歡吃飯，我媽媽喜歡吃麵。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba xǐhuān chī fàn, wǒ māma xǐhuān chī miàn.
examples.english: My dad likes to eat rice, my mom likes to eat noodles.

examples.chinese: 我的女朋友很喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ péngyǒu hěn xǐhuān hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: My girlfriend likes bubble milk tea very much.

examples.chinese: 台灣夏天的天氣很熱，很多人都喜歡喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de tiānqì hěn rè, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuān hē yǐnliào.
examples.english: During summer the weather is very hot in Taiwan, many people like to have beverages.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡聽音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: I like to listen to music.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡去咖啡廳看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān qù kāfēitīng kànshū.
examples.english: I like to read at a café.

examples.chinese: 我很喜歡這家店的巧克力蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè jiā diàn de qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
examples.english: I like the chocolate cake from this shop.

examples.chinese: 哥哥喜歡在床上看書。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐhuān zài chuáng shàng kànshū.
examples.english: My elder brother likes to read in bed.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟喜歡打棒球，我想送他一個棒球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xǐhuān dǎ bàngqiú, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge bàngqiú.
examples.english: My younger brother likes playing baseball, I’d like to give him a baseball as a gift.

examples.chinese: 你喜歡山上的風景還是海邊的風景？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān shānshàng de fēngjǐng háishì hǎibiān de fēngjǐng?
examples.english: Do you like the scenery on the mountain or on the beach?

examples.chinese: 我男朋友不太喜歡說話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nán péngyǒu bú tài xǐhuān shuōhuà.
examples.english: My boyfriend does not like to talk very much.

examples.chinese: 王老師的課很有趣，每個學生都喜歡她。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī de kè hěn yǒuqù, měi ge xuéshēng dōu xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: Teacher Wang’s class is very interesting; every student likes her.

examples.chinese: 她很喜歡花，你可以送她一些漂亮的花。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān huā, nǐ kěyǐ sòng tā yìxiē piàoliàng de huā.
examples.english: She likes flowers very much. You can give her some beautiful flowers.

examples.chinese: 我的興趣是運動，打網球、游泳，我都喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xìngqù shì yùndòng, dǎ wǎngqiú, yóuyǒng, wǒ dōu xǐhuān.
examples.english: My hobby is doing exercise. I like both tennis and swimming.

examples.chinese: 我們都喜歡學（習）中文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xǐhuān xué(xí) Zhōngwén.
examples.english: We all like learning Chinese.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很喜歡畫畫，他畫得很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn xǐhuān huàhuà, tā huà de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That child likes painting and he draws very well.

examples.chinese: 這張畫很好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng huà hěn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: This painting is brilliant. I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 我平常喜歡喝茶，有（的）時候喝一點兒咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng xǐhuān hē chá, yǒu (de) shíhou hē yìdiǎnr kāfēi.
examples.english: I usually like drinking tea. Sometimes I drink a little coffee.

examples.chinese: 很可愛，友美喜歡可愛的東西。
examples.pinyin: Hěn kěài. Yǒuměi xǐhuān kěài de dōngxi.
examples.english: It’s very cute. Youmei likes cute stuff.

examples.chinese: 我想友美喜歡白色，她常常穿白色的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng Yǒuměi xǐhuān báisè, tā chángcháng chuān báisè de yīfu.
examples.english: I think Youmei likes white, she often wears white (clothes).

examples.chinese: 咖啡、茶，我都喜歡。我也很餓，想吃一點兒東西。
examples.pinyin: Kāfēi, chá, wǒ dōu xǐhuān. Wǒ yě hěn è, xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
examples.english: Coffee and tea, I like them both. I am also hungry; I would like to have some food.

examples.chinese: 我不喜歡跑步，我跑步跑得很慢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān pǎobù, wǒ pǎobù pǎo de hěn màn.
examples.english: I do not like to run; I run slowly.

examples.chinese: 元真，妳的這條裙子真好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, nǐ de zhè tiáo qúnzi zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: Yuanzhen, your skirt is very beautiful; I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

items.wordHook: 喜(like) + 歡(happy) → to like is to feel happy about someone or something.

examples.chinese: 我的錢包在哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Where is my wallet?

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想去哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Sounds great! Where do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 妳知道去哪裡買這個牌子的衣服嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào qù nǎlǐ mǎi zhè ge páizi de yīfu ma?
examples.english: Do you know where you can get this clothing brand?

examples.chinese: 你覺得哪裡不舒服？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nǎlǐ bù shūfu?
examples.english: Where are you uncomfortable? (What brings you here today?)

items.wordHook: 哪(which) + 裡(inside) → 'which place?' 哪裡 means where.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡聽音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: I like to listen to music.

examples.chinese: 我要在家看書、聽音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zài jiā kànshū, tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: I am going to read and listen to music at home.

examples.chinese: 可是我只想聽音樂、睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tīng yīnyuè, shuìjiào.
examples.english: But I only want to listen to music and sleep.

examples.chinese: 我在學校，你要來這裡嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéxiào, nǐ yào lái zhèlǐ ma?
examples.english: I am at the school. Do you want to come here? (Are you coming?)

examples.chinese: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。
examples.pinyin: A! Zài zhèlǐ! Qiánbāo zài wǒ de shū xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Ah! There it is! The wallet is under my book.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 妳看，這條黃色的褲子不錯吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè tiáo huángsè de kùzi búcuò ba?
examples.english: Look! This pair of yellow pants is nice, isn’t it?

items.wordHook: 褲(pants) + 子(noun suffix): a pair of pants → 子 just makes it a noun.

examples.chinese: 考試開始以後，我們不可以跟同學說話。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ yǐhòu, wǒmen bù kěyǐ gēn tóngxué shuōhuà.
examples.english: After the exam starts, we cannot talk with classmates.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，她常跟朋友一起去跑步。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, tā cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù pǎobù.
examples.english: After getting off work, she often goes running with friends.

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 我希望以後可以去他家玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng yǐhòu kěyǐ qù tā jiā wán.
examples.english: I hope that in the future I can go to his house to have fun.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，每個週末我都有很多活動，覺得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu yǒu hěn duō huódòng, juéde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have many activities every weekend and feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，我認識了很多國家的新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, wǒ rènshi le hěn duō guójiā de xīn péngyǒu.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have met many new friends from many countries.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫是畢業以後到美國去工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shì bìyè yǐhòu dào Měiguó qù gōngzuò.
examples.english: His plan is to go to the United States to work after graduation.

examples.chinese: 哥哥洗澡以後都先喝一瓶牛奶再睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐzǎo yǐhòu dōu xiān hē yì píng niúnǎi zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: After my older brother takes a shower, he always first drinks a bottle of milk and then goes to sleep.

examples.chinese: 念了一個小時的書以後，你最好休息十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Niàn le yī ge xiǎoshí de shū yǐhòu, nǐ zuìhǎo xiūxi shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: After studying for an hour, you had better rest for ten minutes.

examples.chinese: 這種藥很有用，吃了以後頭就不疼了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào hěn yǒuyòng, chī le yǐhòu tóu jiù bù téng le.
examples.english: This kind of medicine is very useful; after taking it, your head won't hurt anymore.

examples.chinese: 下課以後，我要跟同學討論去日月潭旅行的事情。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ yào gēn tóngxué tǎolùn qù Rìyuètán lǚxíng de shìqing.
examples.english: After class, I want to discuss the trip to Sun Moon Lake with my classmates.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"付了房租以後，你這個月的獎學金還剩多少？","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"弟弟把菜都吃完了，什麼都沒剩。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Fù le fángzū yǐhòu, nǐ zhège yuè de jiǎngxuéjīn hái shèng duōshǎo? Dìdi bǎ cài dōu chī wán le, shénme dōu méi shèng.
examples.english: After paying the rent, how much of this month's scholarship do you still have left? My little brother ate all the food; nothing is left.

examples.chinese: 山本良介來台灣以後，搬了兩次家。
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, bān le liǎng cì jiā.
examples.english: After Yamamoto Ryosuke came to Taiwan, he moved house twice.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"暑假出國旅遊的人很多。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這次的旅遊真有意思，我以後還想多去幾個地方玩。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià chūguó lǚyóu de rén hěn duō. Zhè cì de lǚyóu zhēn yǒu yìsi, wǒ yǐhòu hái xiǎng duō qù jǐ gè dìfang wán.
examples.english: Many people travel abroad during summer vacation. This trip is really interesting; in the future I want to go to more places to have fun.

examples.chinese: 請你想像一下，二十年以後，你的生活會怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiǎngxiàng yíxià, èrshí nián yǐhòu, nǐ de shēnghuó huì zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Please imagine: twenty years from now, what will your life be like?

examples.chinese: 他的英文、日文都很好，畢業以後想當翻譯。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Yīngwén, Rìwén dōu hěn hǎo, bìyè yǐhòu xiǎng dāng fānyì.
examples.english: His English and Japanese are both very good; after graduation he wants to be a translator.

examples.chinese: 他很煩惱，不知道畢業以後要找什麼工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn fánnǎo, bù zhīdào bìyè yǐhòu yào zhǎo shénme gōngzuò.
examples.english: He is very worried, not knowing what job to look for after graduation.

examples.chinese: 隔壁的王媽媽化妝以後，變年輕了。
examples.pinyin: Gébì de Wáng māma huàzhuāng yǐhòu, biàn niánqīng le.
examples.english: After putting on makeup, Mrs. Wang next door became younger.

examples.chinese: 運動以後最好喝開水，不要喝太甜的飲料。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐhòu zuì hǎo hē kāishuǐ, bùyào hē tài tián de yǐnliào.
examples.english: After exercising, it's best to drink boiled water, not drinks that are too sweet.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"參加社團活動，是讓自己成長的好機會。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"孩子出國留學以後，父母發現孩子成長了不少。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

examples.chinese: 王教授退休以後，每個週末都去育幼院陪孩子讀書。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuìxiū yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò dōu qù yùyòuyuàn péi háizi dúshū.
examples.english: After Professor Wang retired, every weekend he goes to the orphanage to accompany the children in reading.

examples.chinese: 爸爸下班以後，總是先洗個澡、喝個飲料，再吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Bàba xiàbān yǐhòu, zǒngshì xiān xǐ ge zǎo, hē ge yǐnliào, zài chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After work, Dad always first takes a shower, has a drink, and then eats dinner.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我參加了愛心服務社以後，想法比以前更成熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"香蕉還沒成熟的時候是綠色的，等變成黃色就熟了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le àixīn fúwùshè yǐhòu, xiǎngfǎ bǐ yǐqián gèng chéngshú le. Xiāngjiāo hái méi chéngshú de shíhou shì lǜsè de, děng biàn chéng huángsè jiù shú le.
examples.english: After I joined the volunteer service club, my thinking has become more mature than before. When bananas are not yet ripe, they are green; when they turn yellow, they are ripe.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"太陽每天都是從東方出來，從西方下去的。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"以凡學了中文以後，他覺得東方文化和西方文化很不一樣。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: 1. Tàiyáng měitiān dōu shì cóng dōngfāng chūlái, cóng xīfāng xiàqù de. 2. Yǐfán xué le Zhōngwén yǐhòu, tā juéde dōngfāng wénhuà hé xīfāng wénhuà hěn bù yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. The sun every day comes out from the east and goes down in the west. 2. After Yifan learned Chinese, he felt that Eastern culture and Western culture are very different.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"太陽每天都是從東方出來，從西方下去的。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"以凡學了中文以後，他覺得東方文化和西方文化很不一樣。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: 1. Tàiyáng měitiān dōu shì cóng dōngfāng chūlái, cóng xīfāng xiàqù de. 2. Yǐfán xué le Zhōngwén yǐhòu, tā juéde dōngfāng wénhuà hé xīfāng wénhuà hěn bù yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. The sun every day comes out from the east and goes down in the west. 2. After Yifan learned Chinese, he felt that Eastern culture and Western culture are very different.

examples.chinese: 店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de kōngqì biàn gānjìng le, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi yǒu jiéyùn yǐhòu, kāichē de rén bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.
examples.english: The air in this city has become cleaner, mainly because after the MRT was built, fewer people drive than before.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 這種鬧鐘有點特別，響了以後得按三下才能關掉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng nàozhōng yǒudiǎn tèbié, xiǎng le yǐhòu děi àn sān xià cái néng guān diào.
examples.english: This kind of alarm clock is a bit special: after it rings, you have to press it three times before you can turn it off.

examples.chinese: 自從有了抽號機以後，人們就不需要站著排隊了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le chōuhàojī yǐhòu, rénmen jiù bù xūyào zhànzhe páiduì le.
examples.english: Ever since there have been queue ticket dispensers, people no longer need to stand in line.

examples.chinese: 吃了健康食品以後，還是得經常運動才能擁有好身材。
examples.pinyin: Chī le jiànkāng shípǐn yǐhòu, háishì děi jīngcháng yùndòng cái néng yōngyǒu hǎo shēncái.
examples.english: After eating health food, you still need to exercise regularly to have a good figure.

examples.chinese: 註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
examples.pinyin: Zhù le cè yǐhòu, xīnshēng yào bǎ xiāngguān zhèngjiàn gè yǐngyìn yī fèn, jiāo gěi xuéxiào.
examples.english: After registering, new students must photocopy one copy of each relevant document and submit them to the school.

examples.chinese: 食品罐頭吃完以後把罐子洗乾淨，就可以回收了。
examples.pinyin: Shípǐn guàntou chī wán yǐhòu bǎ guànzi xǐ gānjìng, jiù kěyǐ huíshōu le.
examples.english: After you finish eating canned food, wash the can clean, and then it can be recycled.

examples.chinese: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng yīnyuè xuéyuàn bìyè yǐhòu jiù jiārù gējùtuán, dào shìjiè gèdì biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: After graduating from the music conservatory, he joined an opera troupe and performed all over the world.

examples.chinese: 自從他改變飲食習慣以後，就變得既健康又有活力。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn yǐhòu, jiù biàn de jì jiànkāng yòu yǒu huólì.
examples.english: Ever since he changed his eating habits, he has become both healthy and full of vitality.

examples.chinese: 自從住校以後，我得學習自己收拾、整理房間。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhùxiào yǐhòu, wǒ děi xuéxí zìjǐ shōushi, zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
examples.english: Ever since I started living at school, I have had to learn to tidy up and organize my room myself.

examples.chinese: 知道自己誤會別人以後，最好早一點兒跟對方道歉。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào zìjǐ wùhuì biérén yǐhòu, zuì hǎo zǎo yīdiǎnr gēn duìfāng dàoqiàn.
examples.english: After you realize you have misunderstood someone, it's best to apologize to the other person a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 考完試以後，我們去海洋公園開開心心地玩一場吧。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo wán shì yǐhòu, wǒmen qù hǎiyáng gōngyuán kāikāixīnxīn de wán yì chǎng ba.
examples.english: After the exam is over, let's go to Ocean Park and have a fun time.

examples.chinese: 有些事明明不對，卻因沒人敢說，久了以後就被社會接受了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì míngmíng bù duì, què yīn méi rén gǎn shuō, jiǔ le yǐhòu jiù bèi shèhuì jiēshòu le.
examples.english: Some things are obviously wrong, yet because no one dares to speak up, after a long time they are accepted by society.

examples.chinese: 他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng děng Zhōngwén chéngdù dádào gāojí yǐhòu, jiù lái Táiwān niàn dàxué.
examples.english: He wants to wait until his Chinese proficiency reaches the advanced level, and then come to Taiwan to attend university.

examples.chinese: 自從開始掉頭髮以後，醫師就建議他每天吃半顆維他命。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ diào tóufa yǐhòu, yīshī jiù jiànyì tā měitiān chī bàn kē wéitāmìng.
examples.english: Ever since he started losing hair, the doctor has suggested he take half a vitamin pill every day.

items.wordHook: 以(yǐ) + 後(behind) → what comes behind this moment: 以後(afterward; in the future).

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

items.wordHook: a 辶(movement) road takes a 隹(bird) forward → ready to 進(get in).

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我家只有爸爸、媽媽和我三口人。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"臭豆腐太臭了，有的外國人吃了一口就不吃了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhǐyǒu bàba, māma hé wǒ sān kǒu rén. / Chòu dòufu tài chòu le, yǒude wàiguó rén chī le yì kǒu jiù bù chī le.
examples.english: There are only three people in my family: Dad, Mom, and me. / Stinky tofu is too stinky; some foreigners take one bite and then don't eat any more.

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 臭豆腐是臺灣有名的小吃，不過味道很獨特，不是每個人都能接受。
examples.pinyin: Chòu dòufu shì Táiwān yǒumíng de xiǎochī, búguò wèidào hěn dútè, bú shì měi ge rén dōu néng jiēshòu.
examples.english: Stinky tofu is a famous snack in Taiwan, but its flavor is very unique; not everyone can accept it.

examples.chinese: 哇！這家小吃店的臭豆腐好辣、好臭哇！怎麼有客人受的了這種味道哇？
examples.pinyin: Wa! Zhè jiā xiǎochī diàn de chòu dòufu hǎo là, hǎo chòu wa! Zěnme yǒu kèrén shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng wèidào wa?
examples.english: Wow! The stinky tofu at this snack shop is so spicy and smells so stinky! How can any customer stand this smell?

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 算起來我們已經好久沒吃餃子了，買點兒麵粉、青菜和肉，回家包餃子吧。
examples.pinyin: Suàn qǐlái wǒmen yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méi chī jiǎozi le, mǎi diǎnr miànfěn, qīngcài hé ròu, huí jiā bāo jiǎozi ba.
examples.english: Counting it up, we haven't eaten dumplings for a long time; let's buy some flour, vegetables, and meat, and go home to make dumplings.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我喜歡週末跟家人聚在一起吃飯、聊天。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"愛心服務社把社員的愛心聚在一起，到安養院去幫助老人。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhōumò gēn jiārén jù zài yīqǐ chīfàn, liáotiān. Àixīn fúwùshè bǎ shèyuán de àixīn jù zài yīqǐ, dào ānyǎngyuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
examples.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.
examples.english: The teacher divided the members of the nursing home club into two groups: the first group sang songs with the elderly, and the second group played games with the elderly.

examples.chinese: 這個週末以前，超過三千塊錢的東西都可以打九折，請把握機會。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò yǐqián, chāoguò sānqiān kuài qián de dōngxi dōu kěyǐ dǎ jiǔzhé, qǐng bǎwò jīhuì.
examples.english: Before this weekend, anything over 3,000 dollars is 10% off—please seize the opportunity.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 收到帳單的時候得準時去繳費，以免超過時間後得繳更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào zhàngdān de shíhou děi zhǔnshí qù jiǎofèi, yǐmiǎn chāoguò shíjiān hòu děi jiǎo gèng duō qián.
examples.english: When you receive the bill, you must go pay it on time, so as to avoid having to pay more money after the deadline.

examples.chinese: 你搭飛機去美國的話，得確認行李有沒有超過五十磅，多了就得付錢了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dā fēijī qù Měiguó de huà, děi quèrèn xínglǐ yǒu méiyǒu chāoguò wǔshí bàng, duō le jiù děi fù qián le.
examples.english: If you take a plane to the US, you have to confirm whether your luggage exceeds fifty pounds; if it's over, you'll have to pay.

examples.chinese: 購物是一種享受，超過個人需求的消費，卻只會帶來煩惱。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shì yī zhǒng xiǎngshòu, chāoguò gèrén xūqiú de xiāofèi, què zhǐ huì dàilái fánnǎo.
examples.english: Shopping is a kind of enjoyment, but spending that exceeds personal needs only brings worries.

examples.chinese: 向圖書館借的書籍要是超過規定的時間沒還，可是要罰錢的。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng túshūguǎn jiè de shūjí yàoshi chāoguò guīdìng de shíjiān méi huán, kěshì yào fá qián de.
examples.english: If books borrowed from the library are not returned within the stipulated time, you will indeed be fined money.

examples.chinese: 以前學校規定女學生的髮型都要一樣，而且長度不能超過耳朵。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián xuéxiào guīdìng nǚ xuéshēng de fàxíng dōu yào yīyàng, érqiě chángdù bùnéng chāoguò ěrduo.
examples.english: In the past, the school required that female students' hairstyles all be the same, and the length could not exceed the ears.

examples.chinese: 根據美國某項研究資料，青少年因腦震盪而被送到醫院的意外中，超過一半是因為激烈運動引起的。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Měiguó mǒu xiàng yánjiū zīliào, qīngshàonián yīn nǎozhèndàng ér bèi sòng dào yīyuàn de yìwài zhōng, chāoguò yībàn shì yīnwèi jīliè yùndòng yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: According to a certain American research study, among accidents in which teenagers are sent to the hospital due to cerebral concussion, more than half are caused by intense sports.

examples.chinese: 阿里山上的樹木又高又粗，好幾棵樹木的年齡都超過一千年了。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān shàng de shùmù yòu gāo yòu cū, hǎojǐ kē shùmù de niánlíng dōu chāoguò yīqiān nián le.
examples.english: The trees on Alishan are both tall and thick; several of them are over a thousand years old.

examples.chinese: 這次申請獎學金，達到標準的學生總共不超過十人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn, dádào biāozhǔn de xuéshēng zǒnggòng bù chāoguò shí rén.
examples.english: For this scholarship application, the students who meet the standard total no more than ten people.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，你們要戴口罩，也要常常洗手。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, nǐmen yào dài kǒuzhào, yě yào chángcháng xǐshǒu.
examples.english: Many people got sick lately. You need to wear a surgical mask and wash your hands often.

items.wordHook: a 冂(frame) rests around 一(one) open space → the speaking 口(mouth).

examples.chinese: 我嚐了一口納豆就不敢吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángle yì kǒu nàdòu jiù bù gǎn chī le.
examples.english: I took one taste of natto and didn't dare eat it anymore.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese: 她沒有針對此事發表看法，所以不知道她贊不贊成。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhēnduì cǐ shì fābiǎo kànfǎ, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào tā zàn bù zànchéng.
examples.english: She didn't express her views on this matter, so we don't know whether she approves or not.

items.wordHook: To 看(look) a 法(law): 看法 means opinion, viewpoint.

examples.chinese: 顏先生對吃、喝都很講究，吃牛排時應該喝什麼酒，他也很有研究。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiānsheng duì chī, hē dōu hěn jiǎngjiū, chī niúpái shí yīnggāi hē shénme jiǔ, tā yě hěn yǒu yánjiū.
examples.english: Mr. Yan is very particular about eating and drinking; he has also studied what wine should be drunk when eating steak.

examples.chinese: 那個明星對穿著很講究，總是花很多時間，研究什麼上衣配什麼長褲才好看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng duì chuānzhuó hěn jiǎngjiū, zǒngshì huā hěn duō shíjiān, yánjiū shénme shàngyī pèi shénme chángkù cái hǎokàn.
examples.english: That star is very particular about apparel, always spending a lot of time researching what top goes with what pants to look good.

examples.chinese: 白小姐平時對穿著不怎麼講究，衣服穿來穿去總是那幾件。
examples.pinyin: Bái xiǎojiě píngshí duì chuānzhuó bù zěnme jiǎngjiu, yīfu chuān lái chuān qù zǒngshì nà jǐ jiàn.
examples.english: Miss Bai doesn't pay much attention to clothing in normal times; the clothes she wears are always just those few pieces.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，參加正式活動都得好好打扮，服裝也應該講究。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng dōu děi hǎohǎo dǎbàn, fúzhuāng yě yīnggāi jiǎngjiu.
examples.english: Generally speaking, to attend formal events one must dress up properly, and clothing should also be carefully chosen.

examples.chinese: 這對夫婦打扮得相當講究，讓我對他們從事的行業很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù dǎbàn de xiāngdāng jiǎngjiū, ràng wǒ duì tāmen cóngshì de hángyè hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This couple dresses quite elegantly, which makes me very interested in the profession they are engaged in.

items.wordHook: Combining 講(talk) and 究(dig into): 講究 means be particular about, to pay great attention to.

examples.chinese: 小張喜歡閱讀法國的文學作品，透過這些作品，讓他了解了法國文化的特色。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng xǐhuan yuèdú Fǎguó de wénxué zuòpǐn, tòuguò zhèxiē zuòpǐn, ràng tā liǎojiě le Fǎguó wénhuà de tèsè.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang likes to read French literary works; through these works, he has come to understand the characteristics of French culture.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò gǔdiǎn wénxué lái tǎolùn gǔdài yǔ xiàndài de wénhuà chāyì.
examples.english: He discusses the cultural differences between ancient and modern times through classical literature.

examples.chinese: 這次文學比賽，我參加的項目是作文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì wénxué bǐsài, wǒ cānjiā de xiàngmù shì zuòwén.
examples.english: In this literature competition, the event I am participating in is essay writing.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 球員的表現讓教練不斷搖頭，並表示得加強平常的訓練。
examples.pinyin: Qiúyuán de biǎoxiàn ràng jiàoliàn bùduàn yáotóu, bìng biǎoshì děi jiāqiáng píngcháng de xùnliàn.
examples.english: The players' performance made the coach constantly shake his head, and he indicated that they need to strengthen their regular training.

examples.chinese: 喜劇中的男女主角，不論相處過程中碰到多少挫折，結局總是快樂又幸福的。
examples.pinyin: Xǐjù zhōng de nánnǚ zhǔjiǎo, búlùn xiāngchǔ guòchéng zhōng pèngdào duōshǎo cuòzhé, jiéjú zǒngshì kuàilè yòu xìngfú de.
examples.english: In comedies, no matter how many setbacks the male and female leads encounter during their time together, the ending is always happy and blissful.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，到舞廳跳舞的多數是年輕人。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, dào wǔtīng tiàowǔ de duōshù shì niánqīngrén.
examples.english: Generally speaking, most of those who go to the dance hall to dance are young people.

examples.chinese: 不要僅根據表面來判斷一個人或一件事，得花時間深入瞭解。
examples.pinyin: Bùyào jǐn gēnjù biǎomiàn lái pànduàn yī gè rén huò yī jiàn shì, děi huā shíjiān shēnrù liǎojiě.
examples.english: Don't judge a person or a matter based only on the surface; you must spend time to understand deeply.

examples.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
examples.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
examples.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

examples.chinese: 經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò xuèyè jiǎnchá, rénmen jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de xuèxíng.
examples.english: Through a blood test, people can know their own blood type.

examples.chinese: 我們公司的大型宴會活動，一向是宣傳部門負責處理的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de dàxíng yànhuì huódòng, yīxiàng shì xuānchuán bùmén fùzé chǔlǐ de.
examples.english: Our company's large-scale banquet events have always been handled by the publicity department.

examples.chinese: 以前學校規定女學生的髮型都要一樣，而且長度不能超過耳朵。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián xuéxiào guīdìng nǚ xuéshēng de fàxíng dōu yào yīyàng, érqiě chángdù bùnéng chāoguò ěrduo.
examples.english: In the past, the school required that female students' hairstyles all be the same, and the length could not exceed the ears.

examples.chinese: 這場大型戶外活動因為租不到合適的地方，就被取消了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dàxíng hùwài huódòng yīnwèi zū bú dào héshì de dìfāng, jiù bèi qǔxiāo le.
examples.english: This large outdoor event was canceled because a suitable place couldn't be rented.

examples.chinese: 大型體育活動常選擇在都市舉行，主要原因是交通方便。
examples.pinyin: Dàxíng tǐyù huódòng cháng xuǎnzé zài dūshì jǔxíng, zhǔyào yuányīn shì jiāotōng fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Large-scale sports events are often chosen to be held in cities; the main reason is convenient transportation.

examples.chinese: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bùduàn tuīxiāo xīnxíng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn, tōngcháng shì wèile cìjī kèhù gòumǎi.
examples.english: Companies constantly promote new types of electronic products, usually in order to stimulate customers to buy.

examples.chinese: 這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shǐyòng de dàxíng jīxiè quán dōu shì qiǎnlǜsè de, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu tèsè.
examples.english: The large machinery used in this factory is all light green, and looks very distinctive.

examples.chinese: 別看張老闆平日吃的、用的都很省，其實他是某家大型電子企業的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Zhāng lǎobǎn píngrì chī de, yòng de dōu hěn shěng, qíshí tā shì mǒu jiā dàxíng diànzǐ qǐyè de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: Don't be fooled by how economical Boss Zhang is in what he eats and uses every day—he's actually the boss of a large electronics company.

examples.chinese: 我討厭搬家，因為大型的家具不好搬運。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tǎoyàn bānjiā, yīnwèi dàxíng de jiājù bù hǎo bānyùn.
examples.english: I hate moving because large furniture is hard to move.

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) takes a 立(stand) at the front → the honored 位(seat).
A 𠂊(bound hand) pulls free from a rope, leaving it spare — 免(spare).
a 䒑(grass top) hides a 刖(blade) chopping at the feet in front → 前(the front).
Combining 只(only) and 有(have): 只有 means only.
a 扌(hand) holds a young sprout up to the light → budding 才(ability).
Combining 有(have) and 效(result): 有效 means effective.
Combining 海(sea) and 島(island): 海島 means island in the ocean.
The 禾(grain) stacks into a tall heap; your 責(duty) is to keep adding more — 積(store up).
Through tireless 辶(movement) across town, posting signs upon each wooden 扁(board) all around → 遍(everywhere).
A 酉(wine) jar blends flavors with your 己(self) taste, mixing them together → 配(blend).
The 阝(place) marks the spot; the 夅(descend) part shows the motion — 降(descend).
